long_horizon_precision_phase_error.rule: Do not accept reduced precision or relaxed numerical staging solely from local error checks when an iterative or dynamical computation can accumulate phase/state error across a long horizon.

implementation_equivalence_is_not_transf.rule: If full-transfer and no-transfer candidates execute semantically equivalent implementations, timing differences receive zero transfer credit.

weak_reference_speedup_is_not_discovery.source_evidence: v5 Task 10 vertex_cover post-hoc causal audit
weak_reference_speedup_is_not_discovery.rule: A large speedup over the official reference does not establish a strong solver or discovery claim. Every v6 causal win must remain near-parity with the best applicable precommitted strong generic baseline; stronger novelty claims require beating it and passing prior-art review.
weak_reference_speedup_is_not_discovery.evidence_summary: Task-10 sealed TM-BFR remained 13.54x faster than PySAT under repeated timings, but an established-style bitset coloring-bound clique/MIS baseline was 61.02x faster than PySAT and about 4.5x faster than the sealed Lexigen solver.

applicability_must_have_a_denominator.rule: Do not select only tasks where transfer appears promising after source access without reporting the complete frozen screening denominator. v6 freezes a 24-task pool first and treats source-applicability coverage as a scored gate.

allowed_v6_full_use: v6_full may instantiate only these abstract recipes when the hash-pinned frozen source fingerprint satisfies their preconditions.
v6_no_transfer_use: v6_no_transfer receives the same generic operator budget but may not instantiate, imitate, or receive learned recipe compositions or causal IDs.
strong_baseline_use: The strong-baseline arm is independent of transfer memory and may use only STRONG_BASELINE_CATALOG.json under its frozen applicability rules.
evidence_labels_do_not_change_recipe: The v5 evidence annotations above affect interpretation only; the four recipe contents and causal IDs are unchanged from v5.
